notes.title: First update - thanks for the support!
notes.notes:
Hello, I would like to thank everyone who evaluated the game or who commented about it, all criticisms are welcome, here is the first update for the game!

-New Difficulty mode (Original and Easy)
-bug fixes
-some rework on game desing, like position of puzzle objetcs, some new event, new sounds, now you can see the ammo in screen

thanks for the support! :D
